Home.title: Rent a bike, see the city
Home.lede: City bikes and e-bikes by the hour, the day or the week.

pickup.title: Pick up in minutes
pickup.body: Show your booking at the counter and ride away. No paperwork.

helmet.title: Helmet and lock included
helmet.body: Every rental comes with a helmet, a lock and a phone mount.

maps.title: Free route maps
maps.body: Ask for our printed map of the best rides along the river.

Pricing.title: Simple prices
Pricing.lede: No deposit and no hidden fees. Cancel for free up to one hour before.

About.title: About Ridgeline Bikes
About.lede: We are a small, family-run shop by the river. We opened on {opened}.

story.title: Our story
story.body: We started with six old bikes and a garage. Today we look after more than 80 bikes.

visit.title: Visit us
visit.body: 12 River Street. Open every day from 8 am to 7 pm.
